entities.name: Provisional Military Dictatorship of Mughan
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Provisional Military Dictatorship of Mughan was a short-lived anti-communist entity established in the Lankaran region in August 1918 amid the Mughan clashes. It was aligned with White Russian forces and supported by the British military force in Baku known as Dunsterforce.
